新增:
关闭浏览记录
在「设置 › 隐私」中关闭「保存浏览记录」后，看过的帖子、吧与搜索都不再保存
改进:
屏蔽推荐中的吧
推荐帖子的「屏蔽」菜单中可直接屏蔽所在的吧，与其他屏蔽规则一起管理，登录时推荐中也不再出现该吧

从列表打开帖子
帖子中的图片沿用列表中已加载的图片，不再先显示占位图
修复: 经典样式下，顶栏标签旁的搜索按钮无法点按
英文界面下，搜索页的标签文字显示不全
帖子页中楼中楼的图片打开后为黑屏
同一张图片出现两次时，打开图片闪退
部分系统上安装更新时闪退

New:
Turn off history
Turn off Save history under Settings › Privacy, and the threads, forums and searches you visit are no longer saved
Improved:
Hide a forum from For you
A thread's Hide menu in For you can now hide its forum, kept with your other hiding rules; signed in, For you stops recommending it too

Opening a thread from a list
Pictures already loaded in the list stay in place instead of showing a placeholder first
Fixed: In the Classic style, the search button beside the tabs in the top bar couldn't be tapped
In English, the tab titles on the search page were cut off
Pictures in replies under a floor opened on a black screen
Opening a picture that appears twice crashed the app
Installing an update crashed the app on some systems
